description_full: Reservoir Media, Inc. operates as a music publishing company. It operates through two segments, Music Publishing and Recorded Music. The Music Publishing segment acquires interests in music catalogs, as well as signs songwriters. Its Recorded Music segment engages in the acquisition of sound recording catalogs; discovery and development of recording artists; and marketing, distribution, sale, and licensing of the music catalogs. Reservoir Media, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

financial_summary: Reservoir Media, Inc.. is a small-cap communication services business with a $674M market cap on $176M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +13% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 3% against a 7% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests.

The business throws off $50M in free cash flow — roughly 28 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 6.04× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 6.2× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 1.4× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.
Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 48% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
